summary_en: Interim dividend raised 2 yen to 20 yen/share (record date 30 June 2026, effective 20 Aug 2026, 14.2 bn yen total). Full-year dividend forecast revised upward by 6 yen to 44 yen/share (18 yen prev. interim, 20 yen prev. year-end). Revision follows upbeat H2 outlook for Onitsuka Tiger and sports-style segments, FX rate adjustment (USD 150→160, EUR 170→180).
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Full-Year Consolidated Business Forecast for FY12/26 and Interim Dividend (Surplus Distribution) and Revision of Full-Year Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief: On 14 August 2026, ASICS' board approved an interim dividend of 20 yen per share (record date 30 June 2026, effective 20 August 2026, totalling 14.178 billion yen) and revised the full-year dividend forecast upward by 6 yen per share to 44 yen for FY12/26. The interim dividend increased 2 yen from the prior forecast of 18 yen; the year-end dividend forecast was raised 4 yen to 24 yen. The revision reflects upgraded full-year consolidated earnings guidance (revenue to 1,050 billion yen, operating profit to 195 billion yen, net income to 120 billion yen attributable to parent) driven by strong H2 momentum in Onitsuka Tiger and sports-style segments, plus currency rate adjustments (USD 150→160, EUR 170→180, RMB 21→23).
